s: 上個月我開始在臺中上大學，在學校附近租了一個房間。
房間不大，但是有冷氣，也有一個小陽臺。
paragraphs.en: Last month I started university in Taichung and rented a room near campus. It isn't big, but it has air conditioning and a small balcony.

s: 房東是一位六十多歲的阿姨，她每個星期都送水果給我。
晚上我常在陽臺上看書，可以看到很遠的山。
我覺得住在這裡很快樂。
paragraphs.en: The landlady is in her sixties and brings me fruit every week. In the evening I often read on the balcony, and I can see the mountains far away. I'm very happy living here.

mcq.q: 房東每個星期送他什麼？
他在陽臺上可以看到什麼？

tf.s: 他晚上常在陽臺上看書。

s: 週末晚上，我常常和同學去逛夜市。
夜市裡的東西又多又便宜，人也很多。
paragraphs.en: On weekend evenings I often go round the night market with classmates. There's lots there, it's cheap, and it's crowded.

s: 我最喜歡吃雞排和蚵仔煎，同學喜歡喝木瓜牛奶。
吃完以後，我們還會玩一些小遊戲。
上次我玩了三次，拿到一個很大的熊。
paragraphs.en: My favourites are fried chicken cutlet and oyster omelette; my classmate likes papaya milk. After eating we play some little games too. Last time I played three times and won a huge teddy bear.

s: 今年春假，我跟家人去花蓮玩了三天。
我們坐火車去，路上可以看到藍藍的海，非常漂亮。
paragraphs.en: This spring break I spent three days in Hualien with my family. We went by train and could see the blue sea along the way — beautiful.

s: 第一天我們去太魯閣，那裡的山又高又美。
第二天爸爸租了腳踏車，我們沿著海邊騎了兩個小時。
雖然很累，但是大家都很開心。
paragraphs.en: On the first day we went to Taroko; the mountains there are tall and lovely. On the second day Dad rented bikes and we rode along the coast for two hours. It was tiring, but everyone was happy.

mcq.q: 在火車上可以看到什麼？

tf.s: 騎完腳踏車大家都不開心。

s: 每年五月到六月是臺灣的梅雨季。
這個時候常常下雨，有時候一下就是一個星期。
paragraphs.en: Every year May to June is Taiwan's plum-rain season. It rains a lot then — sometimes for a whole week at a time.

s: 衣服洗了以後很難乾，房間裡也很溼。
媽媽每天都要開除溼機，不然牆上會長東西。
我不喜歡梅雨季，因為不能出去打球。
paragraphs.en: Washed clothes are slow to dry and the rooms are damp. Mom has to run the dehumidifier every day, or things grow on the walls. I don't like the plum-rain season because I can't go out to play ball.

mcq.q: 梅雨季有時候會下多久的雨？
梅雨季的時候衣服怎麼樣？
媽媽為什麼每天開除溼機？
mcq.en: Or things grow on the walls.

mcq.q: 他為什麼不喜歡梅雨季？

s: 現在我很少去商店買衣服，大部分都在網路上買。
在網路上買東西很方便，晚上在家就可以看。
paragraphs.en: These days I rarely buy clothes in shops; I buy most of them online. It's convenient — I can browse at home in the evening.

s: 買好以後，東西會送到我家附近的便利商店，
我下班順便去拿。
可是上次我買的褲子太長了，只好再寄回去換。
所以現在我買以前都會先看清楚大小。
paragraphs.en: Once ordered, things are delivered to the convenience store near my home, and I pick them up on my way back from work. But last time the trousers I bought were too long, so I had to post them back to exchange. So now I check the size carefully before I buy.

glossary.en: to have no choice but to

mcq.q: 他現在大部分的衣服在哪裡買？

mcq.en: A convenience store near his home.

mcq.q: 上次的褲子有什麼問題？
現在他買以前會做什麼？

tf.s: 上次的褲子他寄回去換了。
在網路上買東西很不方便。

s: 下個星期是期中考，所以這幾天大家都很忙。
我每天下課以後都去圖書館讀書，讀到晚上九點才回家。
paragraphs.en: Next week is midterms, so everyone is busy these days. Every day after class I study in the library and only go home at nine in the evening.

s: 我的數學不太好，所以請同學幫我。
他教得很清楚，我現在比以前懂多了。
考完試以後，我想請他吃一頓飯。
paragraphs.en: My maths isn't very good, so I asked a classmate to help. He explains very clearly, and now I understand much more than before. After the exams I want to treat him to a meal.

mcq.q: 考完試以後他想做什麼？
mcq.en: Treat his classmate to a meal.

tf.s: 他現在還是完全不懂數學。

s: 在臺灣，很多人騎機車上班、上學。
我爸爸也騎機車，他每天早上先送我去學校，再去公司。
paragraphs.en: In Taiwan many people ride scooters to work and school. My dad rides one too: every morning he takes me to school first, then goes to the office.

s: 騎機車比開車快，也比較好停車。
可是下雨的時候要穿雨衣，很不方便。
爸爸說騎車一定要戴安全帽，也不能騎太快。
paragraphs.en: A scooter is faster than a car and easier to park. But when it rains you have to wear a raincoat, which is a nuisance. Dad says you must always wear a helmet and never ride too fast.

mcq.q: 爸爸每天早上先做什麼？
爸爸說騎車一定要做什麼？
他覺得下雨天騎機車怎麼樣？

tf.s: 在臺灣騎機車的人很少。
爸爸說騎車可以騎很快。

s: 我小時候很怕水，所以一直沒有學游泳。
去年夏天，我終於報名了游泳課，每個星期上兩次。
paragraphs.en: I was afraid of water as a child, so I never learned to swim. Last summer I finally signed up for swimming lessons, twice a week.

s: 教練非常有耐心，第一堂課只讓我們在水裡走路。
一個月以後，我已經可以游二十五公尺了。
現在游泳是我最喜歡的運動，身體也比以前好。
paragraphs.en: The coach is very patient; in the first lesson he only had us walk in the water. A month later I could already swim twenty-five metres. Now swimming is my favourite sport, and I'm healthier than before.

mcq.q: 他小時候為什麼沒有學游泳？
游泳課一個星期上幾次？
一個月以後他可以游多遠？
現在他最喜歡什麼運動？
mcq.zh: 「現在游泳是我最喜歡的運動」。

tf.s: 他是今年春天開始學游泳的。
學游泳以後他的身體比以前好。

panels: two people eating bowls of noodles at a small noodle shop; the wall behind them is plain, with no menu, no signs and no boards
a girl washing clothes by hand in a basin
a woman riding a bicycle along a street
children playing happily in the snow
a man jogging along a riverside path in the morning
an old man reading a book on a bench

questions.zh: 「每天早上都去跑步」：E 是早上在河邊跑步的男人。
questions.en: "He goes running every morning": E.

questions.zh: 「正在洗衣服」：B 是在洗衣服的女孩。
questions.en: "My little sister is washing clothes": B.

questions.q: 外面下雪了，孩子們很高興。
questions.zh: 「下雪了，孩子們很高興」：D 是在雪裡玩的孩子。
questions.en: "It's snowing and the children are happy": D.

questions.zh: 「這家店的麵很好吃」：A 是在麵店吃麵的兩個人。
questions.en: "This shop's noodles are delicious": A.

questions.zh: 「爺爺在看書」：F。C（騎腳踏車的女人）是多出來的。
questions.en: "Grandpa is reading": F. C is the spare picture.

questions.zh: 「可以……嗎？」是客氣地問：你可以幫我一下嗎？
questions.en: 可以…吗? asks politely: could you help me a moment?

questions.q: 他（　）台南來，第一次來台北。
questions.zh: 「從＋地方＋來」：他從台南來。
questions.en: 从 + a place + 来: he comes from Tainan.

questions.q: 老師（　）我們明天早一點來學校。
questions.zh: 「讓」＋人＋做事：老師讓我們明天早一點來。
questions.en: 让 + someone + do something: the teacher told us to come earlier tomorrow.

questions.zh: 「一起」：我們晚上一起去看電影吧！
questions.en: 一起, together: let's go to a film together tonight!

questions.zh: 動詞＋「得」＋怎麼樣：他跑得很快。「因為」是多出來的。
questions.en: Verb + 得 + how: he runs fast. 因为 is the spare.

questions.zh: 不上班，「所以我想多睡一會兒」。
questions.en: No work today, "so I want to sleep a bit longer".

questions.zh: 學校很近，所以「我們走路去吧」。
questions.en: The school is close, so "let's walk".

questions.zh: 「聽得懂一點，但是不太會說」：聽和說對比。
questions.en: "I understand a little, but I can't really speak it."

questions.zh: 衣服小，所以說「你可以穿這件大的」。
questions.en: Too small, so "you can wear this bigger one".

questions.zh: 媽媽打電話來，「她說晚上再打給你」。F「我已經吃過了」是多出來的。
questions.en: Mum called; "she says she'll call you again tonight". F is the spare.

questions.zh: 問「經常運動嗎？」，回答「我每個星期都去游泳。」
questions.en: "Do you exercise often?" — "I go swimming every week."

questions.zh: 收到東西，說「謝謝，我很喜歡。」
questions.en: "This is for you." — "Thank you, I love it."

questions.zh: 問「是誰」，回答「他是我的大學同學。」
questions.en: "Who is that?" — "My university classmate."

questions.zh: 問「在哪裡」，回答「就在學校旁邊。」
questions.en: "Where is the hospital?" — "Right next to the school."

questions.zh: 問「怎麼不去」是問原因：「因為我要準備考試。」A 是多出來的。
questions.en: "Why aren't you going out today?" — "Because I have to prepare for an exam." A is the spare.

items.text: 我比哥哥小三歲，哥哥今年二十五歲。

tr.en: I'm three years younger than my brother, who is twenty-five this year.

questions.zh: 哥哥二十五歲，「我比哥哥小三歲」，所以是二十二歲。
questions.en: Twenty-five minus three: twenty-two.

items.text: 雖然今天下雨，但是我們還是去踢足球了。

tr.en: Although it rained today, we still went to play football.

questions.zh: 「雖然下雨，但是我們還是去踢足球了」。
questions.en: "We still went to play football."

items.text: 我的電腦壞了，今天晚上要請朋友幫我看看。

tr.en: My computer is broken; tonight I'm asking a friend to have a look at it.

questions.zh: 「我的電腦壞了」。
questions.en: "My computer is broken."

items.text: 從我家到公司，坐公車要二十分鐘，走路要半個小時。

tr.en: From my home to the office it's twenty minutes by bus and half an hour on foot.

questions.zh: 「走路要半個小時」；二十分鐘是坐公車的時間。
questions.en: "Half an hour on foot"; twenty minutes is by bus.

items.text: 奶奶今年八十歲了，身體還很好，每天都去商店買菜。

tr.en: Grandma is eighty this year, still in good health, and goes to the shop for groceries every day.

questions.zh: 「每天都去商店買菜」。
questions.en: "Goes to the shop for groceries every day."

panels: a woman running along a riverside path in the morning
a boy brushing his teeth at a bathroom sink
a man waiting at a bus stop in the rain
a girl giving flowers to her grandmother
two students playing basketball
a waiter bringing two bowls of noodles to a table

questions.q: 今天是奶奶的生日，我送她一些花。
questions.zh: 「送花給奶奶」：D。
questions.en: "Grandma's birthday; I give her flowers": D.

questions.q: 您的牛肉麵來了，請慢用。
questions.zh: 「您的麵來了」：F 是送麵的服務員。
questions.en: "Your beef noodles are here": F.

questions.q: 姐姐每天早上都去河邊跑步。
questions.zh: 「每天早上跑步」：A。
questions.en: "My sister runs by the river every morning": A.

questions.zh: 「下雨了，公車還沒來」：C 是在雨中等車的男人。
questions.en: "It's raining and the bus hasn't come": C.

questions.q: 下課以後，他們常常一起打籃球。
questions.zh: 「打籃球」：E。B 是多出來的。
questions.en: "After class they often play basketball": E. B is the spare.

questions.zh: 「已經吃過了」：事情做完了。
questions.en: 已经, already: I've already eaten.

questions.zh: 「你覺得……怎麼樣」：問看法。
questions.en: 觉得, think: what do you think of it?

questions.zh: 「等一下」：等一會兒。
questions.en: 一下 after a verb: wait a moment.

questions.zh: 「因為……」說原因。
questions.en: 因为, because: because of the rain.

questions.zh: 「讓我……」：叫我做某事。A「準備」是多出來的。
questions.en: 让, let / tell: Mum told me to come home early. A 准备 is the spare.

bank: 我們坐捷運去吧，比較快。
所以我想多穿一件衣服。

questions.zh: 起得晚的原因：「因為昨天睡得太晚了。」
questions.en: Why he got up late.

questions.zh: 想買，「可是我沒帶錢」。
questions.en: Wants to buy it, but has no money.

questions.zh: 冷，「所以我想多穿一件衣服」。
questions.en: Cold, so another layer.

questions.zh: 說妹妹的年紀，「比我小兩歲」。
questions.en: Her age: two years younger.

questions.zh: 說感冒：「已經好多了。」B 是多出來的。
questions.en: The cold is much better. B is the spare.

questions.zh: 人太多，「明天再來吧」。
questions.en: Too crowded; come back tomorrow.

questions.zh: 走路上班的原因：家離公司很近。
questions.en: He walks because home is close.

questions.zh: 說東西在哪裡：「都在桌子上。」
questions.en: Where the things are.

questions.zh: 打電話的結果：「他說他下午才到。」
questions.en: What Xiao Wang said.

questions.zh: 客人來了，問「你要喝點什麼嗎？」E 是多出來的。
questions.en: Offering a guest a drink. E is the spare.

items.text: 我住在台中，每個週末都坐火車去台北看我爺爺奶奶。

tr.en: I live in Taichung and take the train to Taipei every weekend to see my grandparents.

questions.q: 他什麼時候去看爺爺奶奶？
questions.zh: 「每個週末都坐火車去台北」。
questions.en: "Every weekend."

items.text: 這家店的東西比那家便宜，所以我常常來這裡買。

tr.en: This shop is cheaper than that one, so I often buy things here.

questions.q: 他為什麼常常來這家店？
questions.zh: 「這家店的東西比那家便宜」。
questions.en: "Cheaper."

items.text: 我弟弟很喜歡運動，他每天下課都去游泳。

tr.en: My younger brother loves sport; he goes swimming after class every day.

questions.q: 他弟弟每天下課做什麼？
questions.zh: 「他每天下課都去游泳」。
questions.en: "He goes swimming."

items.text: 明天要考試，今天晚上我不看電視了，我要準備考試。

tr.en: There's an exam tomorrow, so I won't watch TV tonight; I need to prepare.

questions.zh: 「我要準備考試」。
questions.en: "Prepare for the exam."

items.text: 從我家到學校要走二十分鐘，騎車只要五分鐘。

tr.en: It's twenty minutes on foot from my home to school, and only five by bike.

questions.q: 騎車到學校要多長時間？
questions.zh: 「騎車只要五分鐘」。
questions.en: "Only five minutes."

panels: a man sleeping at his desk in an office
a woman holding a heavy box
a boy eating ice cream on a hot day
a family taking a photo in front of mountains
a girl washing a bowl at the kitchen sink
a doctor giving medicine to an old man

questions.q: 天氣太熱了，我們吃點冰吧。
questions.zh: 「吃冰」：C。
questions.en: "It's hot — let's have some ice": C.

questions.q: 這個箱子太重了，你能幫我一下嗎？
questions.zh: 「箱子太重了」：B。
questions.en: "This box is too heavy": B.

questions.q: 吃完飯以後，女兒幫媽媽洗碗。
questions.zh: 「洗碗」：E。
questions.en: "After the meal my daughter washes the bowls": E.

questions.q: 這個藥一天吃三次，飯後吃。
questions.zh: 「這個藥一天吃三次」：醫生在給藥，F。
questions.en: "Take this three times a day": F.

questions.q: 我們在山上照了很多相。
questions.zh: 「照了很多相」：D。A 是多出來的。
questions.en: "We took lots of photos on the mountain": D. A is the spare.

questions.zh: 「最喜歡」：比其他的都喜歡。
questions.en: 最, most: my favourite song.

questions.zh: 「一起去」：大家一起。
questions.en: 一起, together.

questions.zh: 「可能」：猜想。
questions.en: 可能, probably: it's probably going to rain.

questions.zh: 「旁邊」：在某個地方的邊上。
questions.en: 旁边, next to: there's a convenience store next to my home.

questions.zh: 衣服的量詞是「件」。B「已經」是多出來的。
questions.en: 件 is the measure word for clothes. B 已经 is the spare.

questions.q: 哥哥的中文說得很好，因為
questions.zh: 說得好的原因：每天都練習。
questions.en: He practises every day.

questions.zh: 沒來的原因：「因為他生病了。」
questions.en: Because he is ill.

questions.zh: 別出去的原因：「外面在下大雨。」
questions.en: It's pouring outside.

questions.zh: 忙，「晚上再給你打電話。」
questions.en: Busy; will call tonight.

questions.zh: 公車太慢，「那我們坐計程車吧。」D 是多出來的。
questions.en: The bus is too slow; take a taxi. D is the spare.

questions.q: 我今天下午要去超市買牛奶，
questions.zh: 買牛奶，「還要買一點水果。」
questions.en: Milk, and some fruit as well.

questions.zh: 走了很久，「我們休息一下吧。」
questions.en: After two hours, a rest.

questions.zh: 邀請：「你也來嗎？」
questions.en: An invitation: are you coming too?

questions.zh: 學了多久：「已經學了兩年了。」
questions.en: How long: two years.

questions.zh: 說地方：「就在學校後面。」D 是多出來的。
questions.en: Where it is. D is the spare.

items.text: 我姐姐在一家醫院工作，她每天早上七點就出門了。

tr.en: My older sister works at a hospital and leaves home at seven every morning.

questions.zh: 「她每天早上七點就出門了」。
questions.en: "Seven."

items.text: 今天天氣很好，不冷也不熱，我們去河邊走走吧。

tr.en: The weather is lovely today — neither cold nor hot; let's walk by the river.

questions.zh: 「不冷也不熱」。
questions.en: "Neither cold nor hot."

items.text: 這件衣服有點大，有小一點的嗎？

tr.en: This is a bit big — do you have a smaller one?

questions.zh: 「這件衣服有點大」。
questions.en: "A bit big."

items.text: 我昨天晚上看書看到十二點，所以今天很累。

tr.en: I read until midnight last night, so I'm tired today.

questions.zh: 「昨天晚上看書看到十二點」。
questions.en: "He read until midnight."

items.text: 我們學校旁邊新開了一家咖啡店，咖啡很好喝。

tr.en: A new café has opened next to our school; the coffee is good.

questions.zh: 「新開了一家咖啡店」。
questions.en: "A café."

panels: a woman taking a photo of a temple with her phone
a man fixing a bicycle tyre
a girl singing on a small stage
two people sharing an umbrella on a rainy street
a boy feeding a cat outside a house
a waiter writing down an order at a restaurant table

questions.q: 外面下雨了，我們一起走吧。
questions.zh: 「下雨了，一起走」：D 是兩個人撐一把傘。
questions.en: "It's raining — let's walk together": D.

questions.q: 我的腳踏車壞了，爸爸正在幫我修。
questions.zh: 「腳踏車壞了，在修」：B。
questions.en: "My bike broke; Dad is fixing it": B.

questions.zh: 服務員問要吃什麼：F 是在記下點菜的服務員。
questions.en: "What would you like to eat?": F.

questions.q: 這個廟很有名，我想拍幾張照片。
questions.zh: 「拍幾張照片」：A 是在拍廟的女人。
questions.en: "A famous temple; I'd like some photos": A.

questions.q: 每天下午，弟弟都會給門外的小貓一點吃的。
questions.zh: 「給小貓吃的」：E。C 是多出來的。
questions.en: "Every afternoon my brother feeds the kitten outside": E. C is the spare.

questions.q: 我家（　）公司不遠，走路十分鐘。
questions.zh: 「A 離 B 不遠」：說距離。
questions.en: 离 gives distance: not far from the office.

questions.zh: 「別說話」：叫人不要做。
questions.en: 别, don't: don't talk, the baby's asleep.

questions.q: 她跑（　）很快，每次都是第一。
questions.zh: 「跑得很快」：動詞＋得＋怎麼樣。
questions.en: 得 links a verb and how it is done: runs fast.

questions.q: 我給你（　）一下，這是我的同學小林。
questions.zh: 「介紹一下」：讓人認識。
questions.en: 介绍, introduce: let me introduce my classmate.

questions.q: 你給我打電話的時候，我（　）洗澡。
questions.zh: 「正在洗澡」：那時候在做的事。「還」是多出來的。
questions.en: 正在, in the middle of. 还 is the spare.

bank: 可是我還想再看一會兒。
他每天都練習一個小時。

questions.zh: 生病的結果：「所以她今天沒來上課。」
questions.en: Ill, so she didn't come to class today.

questions.zh: 筆找不到，對方說「你可以用我的。」
questions.en: Lost pen: "You can use mine."

questions.zh: 很晚了，「可是我還想再看一會兒。」
questions.en: It's late, but he wants to read a bit more.

questions.zh: 問郵局在哪裡，回答「就在銀行旁邊。」
questions.en: Where the post office is.

questions.q: 他的鋼琴彈得很好，因為
questions.zh: 彈得好的原因：「每天都練習一個小時。」A 是多出來的。
questions.en: Plays well because he practises daily. A is the spare.

bank: 因為我們家的人都愛吃魚。

questions.zh: 山上冷，「你最好多穿一點。」
questions.en: Cold up the mountain: wear more.

questions.q: 那個穿紅衣服的人是誰？
questions.zh: 問是誰，回答「她是我們的新老師。」
questions.en: Who she is.

questions.zh: 別擔心，「我已經買好票了。」
questions.en: Don't worry — tickets are bought.

questions.q: 聽說那家新開的書店很大，
questions.zh: 書店很大，「我們去看看吧。」
questions.en: A big new bookshop — let's go and see.

questions.zh: 常買魚的原因：「我們家的人都愛吃魚。」E 是多出來的。
questions.en: Why she buys fish. E is the spare.

items.text: 我姐姐在高雄工作，她每個月回家一次。

tr.en: My older sister works in Kaohsiung and comes home once a month.

questions.zh: 「她每個月回家一次」。
questions.en: "Once a month."

items.text: 這家咖啡店的咖啡不太好喝，可是這裡很安靜，我常常在這裡看書。

tr.en: The coffee here isn't great, but it's quiet, so I often read here.

questions.q: 他為什麼常常去這家咖啡店？
questions.zh: 「可是這裡很安靜」。
questions.en: "It's quiet."

items.text: 我妹妹比我高，可是她比我小三歲。

tr.en: My younger sister is taller than me, but three years younger.

questions.zh: 「我妹妹比我高」。
questions.en: "Taller than him."

items.text: 明天是星期六，我和同學要去動物園，你也一起來吧。

tr.en: Tomorrow is Saturday; my classmates and I are going to the zoo — come with us.

questions.zh: 「要去動物園」。
questions.en: "The zoo."

items.text: 老師說，考試的時候不能看手機，也不能說話。

tr.en: The teacher said no looking at phones and no talking during the exam.

questions.q: 考試的時候不能做什麼？
questions.zh: 「不能看手機，也不能說話」。
questions.en: "Look at phones."
